name: HTML - First Steps
description: Your first encounter with HTML - learn about text and basic tags

rules.text: Type any text to get started!
rules.hint: HTML can display text directly. Try typing 'Hello World' or any message you like. This text will appear in the preview!

rules.text: Now wrap your text in a <p> tag
rules.hint: The <p> tag creates a paragraph. Use it like this: <p>Your text here</p>. The opening tag <p> starts the paragraph, and the closing tag </p> ends it.

completion.message: 🎉 Great start! You've learned about text and paragraphs!
